name: plembfin
description: Self-hosted watch history and playstate sync for Plex, Emby, Jellyfin, and Trakt.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent database, configuration, backups, and cached artwork.

ports.name: WebUI
ports.description: Port used by Plembfin's web interface.

variables.name: ADMIN_USERNAME
variables.description: Administrator username. Settings values take precedence after the account is claimed.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Optional initial administrator password. Leave blank to claim the account in the WebUI on first start.
